hooks.prompt: Validate this grading report output: $ARGUMENTS. Check that: 1) All dimension scores are in the range 0-100 or explicitly marked N/A with justification, 2) Each finding includes a code example as evidence and a fix suggestion, 3) Severity levels are one of: critical, major, minor, info, 4) No production code was written directly into submission source files — fix suggestions appear only as examples inside the report content. Respond {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "..."}.

Before the grading session ends, verify completeness: 1) All 8 grading dimensions have been scored or explicitly marked N/A with written justification — dimensions are: component quality, state management, styling/CSS, accessibility, performance, TypeScript usage, testing quality, UX patterns, 2) A weighted composite aggregate score has been computed from the dimension scores, 3) A final grading report has been generated with executive summary, dimension scorecards, findings with evidence, and fix suggestions. Context: $ARGUMENTS. Respond {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing: list what is incomplete or absent"}.
